definition_candidate: Highest-resolution locally materialized representation preserving the exact Photos-edited/trimmed content and a deterministic temporal mapping to current scientific PTS authority.

source_semantics.edit_trim_preservation_rule: Only edited Photos renditions may become analysis sources unless raw master temporal equivalence or an explicit deterministic edit transform is proven.

checksum_policy: SHA256 every materialized representation and store sidecar metadata outside Git; commit only lightweight manifests.

pts_mapping_policy.PTS_EQUIVALENT: Existing temporal labels may transfer directly.
pts_mapping_policy.DETERMINISTICALLY_MAPPABLE: Existing temporal labels may transfer only through an explicit mapping.
